shelf.trigger: Quiet week, no running seats, owner word. Pin a kit SHA. Never a GitHub fork.

ledger.event: Five seat runs measured on one envelope. deepseek-flash direct produced a complete correct lane for USD 0.02 over 1,013,608 tokens; deepseek-v4.1-flash did the same over 3,140,038; qwen3-coder-plus burned 4,898,721 and never committed; claude-sonnet-5 cost USD 1.29 over two runs and wrote no product code. Cache hit rates 92.8 to 98.1 per cent, which is the span F31 now checks. S08, S09 and S10 minted.

F32 landed. node factory/tools/seatReturn.mjs meter <project> reads the qwen usage record, and a return may carry tokens in place of spendUsd when the harness reports no cost. The first row is F32 itself: 1704644 in, 75513 out, 1567488 cached over 27 requests on deepseek-flash. The seat could not paste those numbers because the record is appended on session exit, which is the case the lane was built for. T67. D-50.

D-49 adopted: AGENTS section 5 split into the owner boundaries and the factory provisional ones, sixteen bullets unchanged, 11896 bytes against a 12288 cap. D-51 adopted: writerPath auto with writerModel deepseek-flash and writerMeter deepseek-native, so the router takes api.deepseek.com off-peak and DashScope only on peak or outage; qwen3-coder retired to the excluded block of factory/writer-paths.json. Owner rotated both API keys; the old pair answers 401 and the new pair 200.

Onboarding cost measured for the first time: control-plane packet 38.3 KB of a 44 KB cap, AGENTS.md 11.6 KB of 12 KB, traps digest 11.5 KB and 30 per cent of the packet, headroom 24 traps against twenty added in three days. The board is not the grower; traps.yaml and sparks.json are, being the two stores in the reading path with no window. D-52 orders the remedy and D-53 records the orchestration model read from Otto and Virbos. T04 generalised from the host clock to any value not read in the same act as the write, which is the form that would have caught the T67 row.

Sitting 9 absorbed S08 to S12 as T68 to T71 and the seat packet broke its 26 KB cap in the same act, which is D-52 arriving. Ceilings do not move: X01 is the first live experiment, suspending the packet budget step for 21 days on the hypothesis that the cap is right and the packet is wrong, with F36 the scoping lane that closes it. Six lanes queued in order; F33 and F34 run ALONE because every lane contends on governance surfaces (D-54). Envelope tool-call floor is 40. controlPlane is now the generic owner-selected rather than a vendor id.

Control plane handed off. The board and factory/decisions.json carry everything this tenure learned, including the orchestration model read from Otto and Virbos (D-53) and the governance-maintenance model (D-54); nothing of it is left in the session. X01 is open and is the first exception this repository has taken on purpose rather than by decree.

X01 opened and reverted the same day: it suspended a whole gate step to excuse one cap, switching off F31's prefix guard landed that morning. A suspension must not be wider than its hypothesis. The cap was cleared by compaction, and board.now now carries routing facts only, with the handoff in D-55, because the slice is in every seat's packet.

Seat-packet cap raised 26 to 27 KB by D-56 after compaction failed to close a 0.5 KB gap, held at one KB headroom so the pressure stays. X01 was reverted first: a suspension must not be wider than its hypothesis. F36 brings the packet back under 26 by scoping a seat's traps to its Holds; the cap is not nudged again.

ledger: 2026-09-20 Control plane taken by a Claude Code desktop session, sitting 10. Reading path walked in order: AGENTS.md, the live board slice, the traps digest, factory/CONTROL_PLANE.md, via node factory/tools/packet.mjs cp. State verified at the objects before anything was issued: git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main and this checkout both at 6a5fc14, git status --porcelain empty, factory/envelopes/ holds only README.md, node factory/tools/spark.mjs look prints no open sparks, node factory/tools/experiment.mjs list shows X01 reverted and nothing open, and node factory/tools/landingGate.mjs passed all twenty steps. board.now had gone stale on one line: the reading path is no longer over budget, D-56 having raised the seat cap, so the line now names the headroom instead of a breach. Next act is F33, alone.

2026-09-20 F33 issued to a writer seat, alone, at base f47edce. It does the three things D-52 and D-54 ordered and nobody has built: split the bundled packet gate step so a suspension can be narrower than its hypothesis, which is what X01 got wrong; implement the 80 per cent growth band AGENTS section 4 has required since F0 with nothing enforcing it, banding at 80 and failing only over ceiling; and give spark.mjs the rotation ledger.mjs already has, so the ten absorbed and two dropped sparks leave the control-plane packet. Envelope is 6132 bytes against a 6144 cap, measured by node factory/tools/packet.mjs --check. budgets.json and sparks.json are withheld from the seat: the band needs no new field, and running rotate on the live file is the control plane's act at landing, as ledger rotate is. landing-checks.json is handed over for the lane's duration and the envelope says so rather than doing it silently.

2026-09-20 F33's seat could not be launched from the control-plane session. The worktree is cut at C:/Users/acces/virbk-seats/F33 on branch writer/F33 from c9c277b and the packet is rendered at 33400 bytes, but the first launch returned 'Argument list too long': seat.mjs prescribes passing the packet as an argv string and a packet at cap size exceeds the Windows command-line limit, so the seat died before reading a byte. S13 minted. Stdin is the carrier the harness documents, and the relaunch was refused twice by this session's own tool policy. T35 and CONTROL_PLANE section 3 order the remaining act: run the binary underneath, launch from this session, then hand over the one line and leave, treating the refusal as neither an owner ask nor a reason to wait. The first two were tried; docs/log/f33.md carries the third. F33 stays issued, nothing is running.

2026-09-20 The F33 issuance commit was pushed to main without the skip-ci marker the F31 issuance carried, and both Actions ran. The landing gate went red, correctly: ghaWriter --self-test asserts idle against the live envelopes directory, so the gate is red for as long as any envelope is issued, which is why an issuance skips CI and a landing runs it. The writer Action did not idle. It launched a cloud seat headless with yolo on branch writer/F33, the same branch the local worktree holds, and was stopped by 'API Error: 401 Incorrect API key' from DashScope, not by design: the repository secret still holds the key D-51 retired when the owner rotated the pair. Two things follow. S14 holds the missing check. The stale GitHub secret is an owner ask under writer API keys, and until it is replaced the writer Action is a loud failure rather than the loud skip T55 requires.
